summary: Read a sequence of daily temperatures stored in chronological order. For each day, look only at later days and find the soonest one whose temperature is strictly higher than the temperature on the current day. Write how many days separate those two dates. When no later day is warmer, write 0 at the current position. Print one integer for every input day and keep the same order as the temperatures you read.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
